snippet.title: ClickCrafter Steam Playtest - Opening 15 mins
snippet.description:
Watch the first 15 minutes of the ClickCrafter Steam Playtest, an upcoming dark cozy idle/incremental game with base-building elements and crafting/research-based progression.

Join the playtest and/or wishlist the game on Steam at https://onewinter.net/cc/y

Music by @PurrpleCat.
(v0.2.4b)
